message.content: {"alternatives":[],"likely_cause":{"claim":"The most likely cause is that the edge-auth-b4 node has a significant clock skew due to failed NTP synchronization, causing it to reject tokens as not yet valid and resulting in high 401 error rates and session creation failures for users routed to this node.","evidence_ids":["log:1","log:2","log:4","log:7","log:10","log:3","log:9"]},"missing_evidence":[],"observations":[{"claim":"The edge-auth-b4 node failed NTP synchronization with no response from time source pool_a, with the last successful sync over 2 hours ago.","evidence_ids":["log:1","log:9"]},{"claim":"The edge-auth-b4 node rejected tokens with 'not_yet_valid' errors because the token's 'nbf' (not before) timestamp is about 4 minutes ahead of the local clock, indicating clock skew.","evidence_ids":["log:2","log:4"]},{"claim":"The session-api service shows high 401 unauthorized error rates (up to 91%) for requests routed to edge-auth-b4, while other edge-auth nodes have error rates below 2%.","evidence_ids":["log:3","log:10"]},{"claim":"Session creation failed for 1204 requests routed to edge-auth-b4 in the last 5 minutes, indicating a significant impact on users routed to this node.","evidence_ids":["log:7"]},{"claim":"Other edge-auth nodes (a1, a2, c9) report clock offsets within 50ms of their time source, indicating the issue is isolated to edge-auth-b4.","evidence_ids":["log:6"]}],"outcome":"supported","suggested_checks":["Check the NTP synchronization status and configuration on edge-auth-b4 node.","Verify the system clock and time zone settings on edge-auth-b4.","Review routing policies to identify why a subset of users are routed to edge-auth-b4.","Check for any scheduled load drills or test scenarios that might affect edge-auth-b4, but exclude these from incident analysis as per logs."]}
